title: Law on Amendments to the Law on Banks of the Federation of BiH (Zakon o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o bankama), article 10: environmental, social and governance risks in bank risk management
citation: Službene novine FBiH 22/2025 (26 March 2025), amending the Law on Banks, Sl. novine FBiH 27/17
evidence: Article 23 of the Parliament PDF (opened 2026-11-03): "Ovaj zakon stupa na snagu osmog dana od dana objavljivanja u „Službenim novinama Federacije BiH”." The free issue page https://www.sluzbenilist.ba/page/i/zAWggztz5k76kjn45h70rg88= is headed "Službene novine Federacije BiH broj 22/25 [26.3.2025.]" and lists "UKAZ O PROGLAŠENJU ZAKONA O IZMJENAMA I DOPUNAMA ZAKONA O BANKAMA". Eighth day after 26 March 2025 is 3 April 2025 (computed, not stated).
notes: Bank governance duty, mapped to F1 and not to a sustainability-reporting law: article 10 adds point l) "okolišne, socijalne i upravljačke rizike" to art. 81(1) and defines them in new art. 81(13); art. 22 gives banks six months to comply. The record is the whole amending law (23 articles) as the Parliament copy of the adopted act; the amended Law on Banks (27/17) is not stored. Language: Bosnian (bs) file from the Parliament; Croatian and Serbian versions are published in the gazette, whose act PDFs need a login (BA-SLUZBENILIST-ADOPTED), so they are not stored. English: no government translation found on parlamentfbih.gov.ba or in the sluzbenilist.ba search.

title: Law on Accounting and Auditing in the Federation of BiH (Zakon o računovodstvu i reviziji u Federaciji BiH)
evidence: Final article of the Parliament PDF (opened 2026-11-03): "Ovaj zakon stupa na snagu osmog dana od dana objavljivanja u "Službenim novinama Federacije BiH"." The free issue page https://www.sluzbenilist.ba/page/i/Qly4ggztz5k76kjn45hDMe8g= is headed "Službene novine Federacije BiH broj 15/21 [24.2.2021.]" and lists the act. Eighth day after 24 February 2021 is 4 March 2021 (computed, not stated).
notes: Confirmed: no non-financial or sustainability report duty. Art. 42(1) requires a business report (izvještaj o poslovanju) giving the main risks "kao i mjera poduzetih na zaštiti životne sredine"; art. 42(2) lists the content and has no climate or emissions item; micro and small entities are exempt (art. 42(4)). Kept in F1 as the closest reporting hook. Whether later amendments exist was not checked; only the adopted act is stored. Language: Bosnian (bs) file from the Parliament; Croatian and Serbian versions are published in the gazette, whose act PDFs need a login (BA-SLUZBENILIST-ADOPTED), so they are not stored. English: no government translation found on parlamentfbih.gov.ba or in the sluzbenilist.ba search.

title: Law on Accounting and Auditing of Republika Srpska (Zakon o računovodstvu i reviziji Republike Srpske)
evidence: Final provision of the text posted by the National Assembly (opened 2026-11-03): "Ovaj zakon objavljuje se u „Službenom glasniku Republike Srpske“, a stupa na snagu 1. januara 2026. godine."
notes: Carries a sustainability report duty: art. 38(1) "Velika pravna lica koja su subjekti od javnog interesa dužna su sačiniti i prezentovati izvještaj o održivosti"; the report is a separate section of the business report (art. 38(2)). Defines izvještavanje o održivosti and faktori održivosti among the definitions. The standards the report must follow, the first reporting year and the scope beyond large public-interest entities were not read (only art. 38 and the final provision were checked). The National Assembly page gives Službeni glasnik 115/25 and date 26.01.2026; a decision of 17 December 2025 on early entry into force was found by search and not opened. Language: Serbian (sr), Latin script (the /la/ zip); the Cyrillic /ci/ version exists and is not stored. Bosnian and Croatian versions: not found on the National Assembly page. English: no government translation found there.

notes: Entity environmental framework act. title: Law on Environmental Protection of Republika Srpska (Zakon o zaštiti životne sredine)
citation: Službeni glasnik Republike Srpske 71/12 (amended 79/15 and 70/20 per secondary sources)
evidence: Not stated on an official page that was read: the National Assembly page (opened 2026-11-03) gives "Službeni glasnik: 71/12, Datum: 10.07.2012." without saying whether that is the publication date, and the 2012 text says it enters into force on the eighth day after publication.
notes: Link only: the National Assembly attaches a legacy .doc (inside a zip) that the repo cannot read, and no publication date was read from an official page, so no dated record could be written. The 2012 text mentions the climate only in a general sentence on air protection (art. on zaštita vazduha). The amending laws 79/15 and 70/20 were not read; the 70/20 page is on the same site. English: none looked for beyond the National Assembly page. Republika Srpska climate law: only a working draft per the earlier register note, not opened.
status_note: No readable official file and no publication date; see notes.

title: Law on Consumer Protection in Bosnia and Herzegovina (Zakon o zaštiti potrošača u Bosni i Hercegovini)
evidence: Not read: the sluzbenilist.ba search result (opened 2026-11-03) lists "ZAKON O ZAŠTITI POTROŠAČA U BOSNI I HERCEGOVINI, Službeni glasnik BiH broj 25/06, 04.04.2006" and the Pregled link opens a login dialog, so neither the text nor a commencement clause could be seen.
notes: Link only: gazette text is behind a login (permission requested). Umbrella consumer law for misleading commercial claims; it has no environmental-claims provision that was read. A 17/02 law of the same name is also listed in the search. No state-host copy was found (a search returned only commercial and FAO copies). Amendment 88/15 appears in secondary sources and was not opened.
status_note: Gazette text behind a login; no free official copy found.
